title: Existence of a directed Euler tour in the de Bruijn digraph
statement: For every integer $n \ge 2$, the de Bruijn digraph $D_n$ admits a directed Euler tour: there exist a vertex $u$ and a closed directed walk based at $u$ that traverses each arc of $D_n$ exactly once.
replaced:
\textbf{Book conclusion (\S{}10.5).} \emph{Therefore (exercise 10.3.2) \texttt{D\_n} has
a directed Euler tour. This directed Euler tour, regarded as a sequence of arcs of
\texttt{D\_n}, yields a binary sequence of length \texttt{2$^{n}$} suitable for the
design of the drum surface.}
